subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive (ML/Infra) - scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acmehealthtech.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive (ML/Infra) - scheduling and agenda

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our end: you’re interested in Redwood for lower-latency, cost-predictable inference for the Acme Health clinical NLP pipelines, with particular questions about model ops, TF serving migration, and encryption/key management.

As discussed, the next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra leads to:
- Review current model architecture and inference bottlenecks
- Walk through Redwood’s serving runtime and quantization options
- Discuss deployment patterns (Dedicated vs Private) and KMS/SSO integration
- Define a mutual action plan and success metrics

Proposed windows (PT):
- Mon Apr 17, 10:00–11:30
- Tue Apr 18, 09:00–10:30
- Wed Apr 19, 13:00–14:30

Camila (cc’d) will join from our infra team. If you can confirm which window works and who from Acme will attend (ML lead, infra/ops, security), I’ll lock in the invite and share a short agenda.

I attached a draft agenda for reference.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_technical_deep_dive_agenda.pdf

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acmehealthtech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive (ML/Infra) - scheduling and agenda

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the agenda. Tue Apr 18 09:00–10:30 PT works best for us. I’ll bring:
- Dr. Lena Ortiz (ML lead)
- Mark Curran (Infra/SRE)
- Our security lead may join depending on KMS/SSO discussion

A couple of asks for the deep dive: please include estimated throughput/latency numbers for 2k-5k QPS, notes on quantization tradeoffs for our clinical models, and a short section on audit logs/data residency.

I’ll confirm the attendee list and send a calendar invite once you confirm the slot.

—Jamie
Sr. Director, Product
Acme Health Tech
jamie.park@acmehealthtech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acmehealthtech.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive (ML/Infra) - scheduling and agenda

Great — Tue Apr 18 09:00–10:30 PT is confirmed on my side.

Camila and I will run the technical deep dive; I’ve looped in Dylan from our serving runtime team to cover performance/quantization details.

Draft agenda (60–90 min):
1) Intros & goals (5–10m)
2) Current Acme architecture & pain points (10–15m) — Jamie/Lena/Mark
3) Redwood serving runtime deep dive (20–25m) — Camila/Dylan
   - KV cache, batching strategies, kernel selection
   - Quantization profiles & accuracy regressions
   - Throughput/latency benchmarks (2k/5k QPS examples)
4) Security & deployment modes (10–15m)
   - KMS/HSM, SSO, audit logs, data residency options
5) Mutual action plan & next steps (10m)

If you want us to add a focused slot on e.g., DocuSign/contracting timeline or PII masking, let me know and we’ll reserve 10 minutes.

I attached the updated agenda + we’ll prepare a short slide deck for the session. Can you confirm final attendee emails and whether you prefer Google Meet or a Webex?

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: redwood_technical_deep_dive_agenda.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acmehealthtech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Technical deep dive (ML/Infra) - scheduling and agenda

Hi Jamie/Marissa —

I’ll lead the runtime section. Quick notes on our prep:
- Dylan will bring benchmark comparisons for float16 vs int8 quantization on N4 GPUs and expected perf delta for sequence lengths similar to your clinical inference (avg seq 512).
- I’ll prepare a short demo of prefix caching and request routing policies that show latency improvements for cold vs warm cache scenarios.
- We’ll include a slide on KMS patterns and audit log capabilities.

We’ve penciled in Tue Apr 18 09:00–10:30 PT and created a tentative calendar invite (Google Meet): https://meet.google.com/redwood-acme-tds (placeholder)

Attachments: deep_dive_slides_v1.pdf, redwood_infra_lightning_chart.png

Looking forward to it —
Camila Reyes
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks everyone. I’m confirming attendees and will send a calendar invite with the final attendee list and any security folks. We’ll plan for Google Meet as listed.

See you Apr 18.

—Jamie
